task.label: 허스키한 젊은 테너(숨 섞인 결)
texts: 거짓말. 안 켜면 그냥 안경이잖아. 난 모리. 근거 없는 말은 안 믿어. 그래서, 나랑 무슨 상관인데? 흐음, 인정. 이번엔 네 말이 맞았어.
task.instruct: Young tenor in his early twenties with a soft breathy husky texture. Friendly teasing tone, easygoing charm, lively rhythm with small playful lifts, smiling while talking, clear consonants. Youthful and warm, light rather than heavy, never sounds middle-aged.
